title: 旅游导游应对AI和社交媒体冲击
titleEn: Tourist guides adapt as AI and social media reshape travel habits
summary: 旅客越来越多使用AI生成行程和社交媒体推荐，旅游导游的机会减少，行业被迫创新适应。
summaryEn: As travelers increasingly rely on AI-generated itineraries and social media recommendations, tourist guides face fewer opportunities and must innovate to adapt.
speaker: Beatrice Yap
